intro: Deathguard Linnea is a Forsaken soldier stationed at a Deathguard waystation in southeastern Tirisfal Glades. She helps secure the roads between Brill and the eastern borders, watching for threats posed by the Scarlet Crusade and lingering Scourge. Adventurers passing along the main thoroughfares often assist her unit with patrol duties.

p: Deathguard Linnea stands sentinel at a small fortified post southeast of Brill. Life—or unlife—on patrol in Tirisfal Glades is treacherous, as the Forsaken must vigilantly defend their fledgling realm against Scarlet Crusade infiltrators and mindless Scourge prowling the wilderness. Stationed alongside her fellow guards, Linnea oversees patrol efforts along the roadway, coordinating reports with local authorities such as Magistrate Sevren in Brill to keep the realm's southern approach secure.
